verdict.rationale: Docs repeatedly show dual-path support for core workflows—payouts, onboarding, disputes, webhooks—explicitly available 'via API' as well as via Dashboard (finix-docs-6,12,17,34), suggesting broad API/UI parity for platform operations. However there is no single authoritative statement guaranteeing full parity across all UI actions, and some UI-only conveniences (manual card entry, dashboard-only report views) aren't clearly mirrored in API docs. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or audit confirming every dashboard action has an API equivalent, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this parity.
